# ACE Organization

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The folders of Atlas, Calendar, and Efforts organizes our thinking in an Obsidian vault based on Ideaverse.

**Also known as:** ACE Folders

## Scope note

- Frameworks and methodology recommended by Nick Milo and Linking Your Thinking (LYT) for linked note systems like Obsidian.

## Broader

- [Ideaverse](../Ideaverse/)
